name: generator_choice
description: Feature requests for this boilerplate. Pick the `generate_feature` generator that gives the best starting point.

state_fields.request: What the developer wants to build

generator.instructions: Which generator is the best starting point for this request?

criteria.api_endpoint: The api_endpoint generator, because the request is a new resource with create, read, update and delete endpoints.
criteria.payments: The payments generator, because the request is about one-time payments, checkout, charges or a payment provider such as Stripe.
criteria.subscription: The subscription generator, because the request is about recurring plans, billing periods, trials or plan upgrades.
criteria.notification: The notification generator, because the request is about sending email, push or in-app notifications to users.
criteria.file_storage: The file_storage generator, because the request is about uploading, storing or serving files, images or documents.
criteria.chat: The chat generator, because the request is about real-time messages or conversations between users.
criteria.organization: The organization generator, because the request is about companies, workspaces, teams or inviting members.
criteria.rbac: The rbac generator, because the request is about roles, permissions or restricting who can do what.
criteria.analytics: The analytics generator, because the request is about tracking events, usage metrics or reports on user behavior.
criteria.cache: The cache generator, because the request is about caching responses or data to make the API faster.
